title.original: Murakkab: Resource-Efficient Agentic Workflow Orchestration in Cloud Platforms
title.zh: Murakkab：云平台中的资源高效代理工作流程编排
title.en: Murakkab: Resource-Efficient Agentic Workflow Orchestration in Cloud Platforms

inclusion_reason.zh: Murakkab 的声明式工作流、跨层优化器和自适应云运行时构成可复用的 Agent 资源编排基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: Murakkab's declarative workflow, cross-layer optimizer, and adaptive cloud runtime form reusable resource-orchestration infrastructure for agents.

abstract.zh: Murakkab 是云端 Agent 工作流的资源感知服务系统，以声明式抽象分离业务流程和模型/硬件执行配置。画像驱动优化器与自适应运行时跨工作流组件、模型和设备联合配置，以满足用户定义的 SLO。
abstract.en: Murakkab is a resource-aware serving system for cloud agent workflows that separates workflow intent from model and hardware configuration through a declarative abstraction. A profile-guided optimizer and adaptive runtime jointly map components to resources under user-defined SLOs.

problem.zh: 现有框架把 Agent 逻辑暴露为不透明的模型/工具序列，并与具体模型和硬件绑定，云调度器无法跨节点权衡准确率、时延、能耗和成本。
problem.en: Existing frameworks expose opaque model/tool sequences tightly coupled to model and hardware choices, preventing cloud schedulers from optimizing accuracy, latency, energy, and cost across the workflow.

approach.zh: 声明式工作流暴露组件依赖和 SLO；离线画像估计各模型/硬件组合，优化器给出映射，运行时再根据实际负载和质量信号动态重配置。
approach.en: A declarative workflow exposes dependencies and SLOs; profiling estimates model–hardware choices, an optimizer selects a mapping, and the runtime reconfigures it from observed load and quality signals.

system_design.zh: Murakkab 控制面解析工作流 DAG、SLO 与画像，统一决定组件编排、模型选择和硬件放置；数据面执行图并向控制器反馈时延、资源与质量观测。
system_design.en: Murakkab's control plane reads the workflow DAG, SLOs, and profiles to jointly choose orchestration, models, and placement. The data plane executes the graph and returns latency, resource, and quality observations.

key_results.zh: 多类工作流评测报告 Murakkab 在维持 SLO 时减少 GPU 使用、能耗和成本，显示跨层配置比不透明执行更高效。
key_results.en: Across diverse workflows, Murakkab is reported to reduce GPU use, energy, and cost while maintaining SLOs, demonstrating the value of cross-layer configuration.

limitations.zh: 优化依赖画像对动态工作流的代表性，重配置可能产生冷启动和状态迁移成本；摘要未讨论跨组织组件、隐私约束或故障恢复。
limitations.en: Optimization depends on profiles remaining representative of dynamic workflows, while reconfiguration can add cold-start and state-migration cost; cross-owner components, privacy constraints, and recovery are not discussed.

workloads: diverse agentic workflows under user-defined SLOs
baselines: existing agent frameworks and cloud schedulers

notes.zh: 云 GPU、SLO 场景及资源/能耗/成本上限来自官方摘要；工作流、模型、设备和具名基线待全文审计。
notes.en: Cloud GPUs, SLO setting, and resource/energy/cost bounds come from the official abstract; workflows, models, devices, and named baselines await full-text audit.
